newsitem.title: GREECE: Olympic Airways wants to improve competitiveness.
newsitem.headline: Olympic Airways wants to improve competitiveness.

text.p: Greece's state carrier Olympic Airways said on Tuesday it has retained management consulting firms McKinsey & Company and Planet to help it on a project to improve competitiveness.
The project, codenamed Olympic Airways 2000, is based on the fact that financial restructuring alone cannot ensure a sustainable and profitable future for the carrier, it said.

"Increasing competitive pressures resulting from changing industry dynamics and performance improvements achieved by Olympic's competitors create the need for a major improvement in competitiveness," Olympic Airways said.
The project's first phase will be completed by May and will recommend a set of improvement initiatives that the carrier should pursue in the next couple of years.
These will include a new organisational structure to facilitate functional improvements and help the company adapt to future market needs.
Also, a set of initiatives to help Olympic Airways increase revenues and reduce operating costs. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
